name: Orbs / wormhole
description: A ring of glossy 3D orbs rotating in space that funnels into a wormhole as the scene runs. The `wormhole` parameter morphs between the two, so one scene can start as an orbiting ring and end as a tunnel.

wormhole.description: 0 = a rotating ring of orbs, 1 = orbs funnelling into a wormhole. Spread across most of the scene so the change is a drift rather than a lurch; set it to a constant to hold either state.

speed.description: Rings pass at speed/1.9 per second. Above ~1.5 it reads as a hurtling tunnel rather than a drift.
